Callout.Name: Assault on a Driver
Callout.Message: Taxi driver assaulted by a passenger.
Callout.Advisory: Driver on scene with a facial injury, suspect gone on foot.

Script.Line: He hit me from the back seat. That is how it happened.
The fare was eleven dollars and he did not want to pay it.
I have got it on the dash camera. It is all on the camera.

Lines.Approach: Passenger has gone and the driver has taken one to the face over a fare.
Lines.SignOff: Show me 10-8 when you are clear.
